entries.reason: No waterborne epoxy floor sealer / coating in the published range.
No chemically resistant epoxy lining for wastewater plants found (Caparol China floor systems state general chemical resistance only; YHEpoxy-AD04 is an epoxy paste adhesive / repair mortar).

No chemically resistant epoxy sealing coating with published data; the series page names SP105 高渗透环氧防水涂料 for sewage-tank anti-corrosion, but it is a high-penetration epoxy waterproofing coat with no TDS or chemical-resistance list.

No polyurethane joint sealant found: YUHONG's sealants are silicones and two-component modified silicone (YS-202, GB/T 14683-2017, for precast-panel joints); OYH export lists silicones and a PU foam gap filler only.
